name: Symbotic Inc
business: Designs, installs and services AI-driven robotic warehouse automation systems for large retailers, grocers and wholesalers, led by Walmart.

events.from: external, EVP and CFO of Avis Budget Group
external, ex CFO Enphase Energy, ex CAO Tesla

events.what: Restatement of Q1 to Q3 FY2024 (Item 4.02, revenue recognition on milestones and cost overruns, material weakness); outside window, context for disqualifier test

next_event.source: No Investor Day or framework update found in Baba corpus for FY2026 (last Investor Day 2023, doc 92984). Founder Rick Cohen CEO since November 2022 per DEF 14A doc 39942; Item 5.02 sweep 2024-07-01 to 2026-10-02 shows no CEO or President change.

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: Total company gross margin. Only current framing is the CFO's 'longer term margin being in the 30 plus' (no year), first heard by us from the new CFO on 2026-05-06; the 2023 Investor Day carried an older 'low 30s' target that analysts dated to 2025 (doc 92984, analyst question only, not verified as management words). Fiscal year ends late September; Baba VA FY = company fiscal year. FY2029 consensus gross margin derived as gross profit / revenue because VA's Gross margin line is blank for FY2029.

statements.quote: I think the bigger message is we do continue to drive for that longer term margin being in the 30 plus.
statements.speaker: Izzy Martins

statements.quote: I would say not necessarily, right. It's not as easy as you would suggest. I think what we manage to is the things that we talked about is really the efficiencies on the execution side and the cost discipline.
statements.speaker: Izzy Martins

street.gap_assumption: Gross margin basis. No target year, so the test uses the last consensus year, FY2029 (VA FY = company fiscal year ending September): 30.63% (gross profit $1,726M / revenue $5,636M) vs management's '30 plus' = -62.6 bps; the street already models the target. Consensus gross margin path: FY2025 actual 21.47%, FY2026 23.49%, FY2027 25.14%, FY2028 27.22%, FY2029 30.63%.
street.source: Baba data_financials fundamentals consensus (Visible Alpha), cid 1005408; data_compute. Uplift is zero because FY2029 consensus already sits above 30%.

evidence_of_progress.note: Gross margin basis, VA actuals: Q1 FY2026 23.37% vs 17.92% = +545.7 bps; Q2 FY2026 24.51% vs 22.70% = +180.5 bps. Q3 FY2026 (reported 2026-08-05) gross margin expanded sequentially and year over year per CFO (doc 129566), VA row still holds consensus. First double-digit adjusted EBITDA margin in Q1 FY2026. 4-month forward EBITDA revision +0.3%, 12-month +4.5%. Net cash $1.32B. Disqualifier tests: FY2025 10-K (doc 24920) still reports a material weakness as of 2025-09-27 tied to the FY2024 restatement; no going-concern or covenant stress; margin is project-execution driven, not commodity driven. EV/EBITDA FY 49.5x: the A leg is mechanical, the stock is not cheap in absolute terms, and pctile covers only 54 months since the 2022 SPAC listing.

disqualifier_reason: Margin target already reflected in consensus: the undated '30 plus' gross margin goal sits 62.6 bps BELOW FY2029 consensus (30.63%). Also flagged, not a listed disqualifier: material weakness from the FY2024 restatement still unremediated at the FY2025 10-K.
verdict: Not a GXO setup: new external CFO but founder CEO in place, the only margin goal is undated and already exceeded by FY2029 consensus, and the stock trades near 50x EBITDA despite the drawdown.
open_questions: Will the new CFO give a dated long-term model (for example at a future Investor Day), and would it sit above the street's 30.6% FY2029 gross margin?
Has the material weakness from the FY2024 restatement been remediated in FY2026?
How much of the FY2028 to FY2029 margin ramp depends on the next-generation storage structure mix that the CFO named as the unlock?
